_about: The self-recall count for Saddleback College's Course Outline report (201) on saddleback.curriqunet.com, which also holds Irvine Valley College's outlines (another report; this count is Saddleback's alone) (kb/_course_outcomes_read.py rows_recall; S691). The host reads outcomes only (d-ccsf-outline-trial-no-staff-names-s689), so the trial filed no page. Each count comes from the page itself: the trial printed each page's SLO and objectives sections, cut by their printed headings alone (EXCERPT_BY_HOST, OBJECTIVES_EXCERPT_BY_HOST), to its job log, and the worker counted the printed lines by eye. Every page answered 200 under both caps. slugs names the college this count stands for: a read for another college on the host is refused.

ACCT 120.from: the page's SLO section (Student Learning Outcomes to its next Course Content heading) and objectives section (Course Content - Learning Objectives to Student Learning Outcomes) as printed in the log of trial 44890274600, job 136804623386, read by eye line by line, apart from the parser; the lead-in lines Students completing this course satisfactorily will be able to: and Students participating in this class will: not counted. The same sections printed identically in the log of trial 44889837642, whose count caught the objectives' lead-in filed as an objective.
